entries.name: Basic Life Support instructor certification
entries.definition: A certification, issued by training organisations such as the American Heart Association and the American Red Cross, that qualifies a person to teach and certify others in Basic Life Support.

entries.name: Board Certified Behavior Analyst
entries.definition: A graduate-level certification, awarded by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, for practitioners of applied behavior analysis.

entries.name: Board Certified Pharmacotherapy Specialist
entries.definition: A specialty certification awarded by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties to pharmacists who show advanced skill in drug therapy.

entries.name: Board Certified Specialist in Gerontological Nutrition
entries.definition: A specialist certification for registered dietitians who work with older adults, awarded by the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

entries.name: Board Certified Specialist in Renal Nutrition
entries.definition: A specialty certification in kidney nutrition for registered dietitians, awarded by the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

entries.name: Board Certified Specialist in Sports Dietetics
entries.definition: A specialist certification for registered dietitians who work with athletes, awarded by the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

entries.name: Board Certified Transplant Pharmacist
entries.definition: A specialty certification awarded by the Board of Pharmacy Specialties to pharmacists who show advanced skill in transplant pharmacy.

entries.name: Boating license
entries.definition: A licence or certificate, issued by a state or country, that allows a person to operate a recreational boat.

entries.name: Boom lift certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained to operate boom lifts, aerial work platforms with an extending arm.

entries.name: CCNA Security
entries.definition: A Cisco associate-level certification for network engineers who secure Cisco network devices and infrastructure.

entries.name: CCNP Security
entries.definition: A Cisco professional-level certification for engineers who design, implement and operate network security.

entries.name: Certificate in Aircraft Maintenance
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in aircraft maintenance.

entries.name: Certificate in Baking and Pastry Arts
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in baking and pastry arts.

entries.name: Certificate in Barbering
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in barbering.

entries.name: Certificate in Dental Assistant
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in dental assisting.

entries.name: Certificate in Electrical Technology
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in electrical technology.

entries.name: Certificate in Masonry
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in masonry.

entries.name: Certificate in Motorcycle Repair
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in motorcycle repair.

entries.name: Certificate in Nail Technician
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in nail technology.

entries.name: Certificate in Paramedic
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in paramedic training.

entries.name: Certificate in Pharmacy Technician
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in pharmacy technician training.

entries.name: Certificate in Physical Therapy Assistant
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in physical therapy assisting.

entries.name: Certificate in Plumbing Technology
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in plumbing technology.

entries.name: Certificate in Veterinary Assistant
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in veterinary assisting.

entries.name: Certificate in Welding Technology
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a college or training school on completing a short programme of study in welding technology.

entries.name: Certificate of Advanced Graduate Study
entries.definition: A post-master's credential awarded by universities for a defined programme of advanced graduate study beyond the master's degree.

entries.name: Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology
entries.definition: The professional certificate from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association showing a speech-language pathologist has met its academic, clinical-practicum and examination requirements.
variants: Certificate Of Clinical Competence In Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)

entries.name: Certification in Neurophysiologic Intraoperative Monitoring
entries.definition: A certification for professionals who monitor the nervous system with electrical tests during surgery to help protect it from injury.

entries.name: Certification in Transportation and Logistics
entries.definition: A professional certification in transportation and logistics management.

entries.name: Certified Addictions Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who specialise in caring for people with addictions, awarded by the Addictions Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Alcoholism and Drug Abuse Counselor
entries.definition: A credential for counselors who treat people with alcohol and drug problems.

entries.name: Certified Ambulatory Perianesthesia Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the American Board of Perianesthesia Nursing Certification for nurses who care for ambulatory patients before and after anesthesia.

entries.name: Certified Analytics Professional
entries.definition: A certification from INFORMS for analytics practitioners who have shown skill across the whole analytics process, from framing the problem to deploying the solution.

entries.name: Certified Apartment Manager
entries.definition: A certification from the National Apartment Association for managers of apartment communities.

entries.name: Certified Associate in Project Management
entries.definition: An entry-level project management certification from the Project Management Institute for people who are new to the field.

entries.name: Certified Associate in Python Programming
entries.definition: An associate-level certification from the Python Institute showing that someone can write and understand programs in Python.

entries.name: Certified Asthma Educator
entries.definition: A certification showing that a health professional can teach people with asthma and their families how to manage the condition.

entries.name: Certified Bariatric Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for nurses who care for patients with severe obesity, including before and after weight-loss surgery.

entries.name: Certified Bath Designer
entries.definition: A certification from the National Kitchen & Bath Association for designers who plan bathrooms.

entries.name: Certified Biomedical Equipment Technician
entries.definition: A certification for technicians who install, maintain and repair medical equipment such as patient monitors and infusion pumps.
